views.description: Renders each identified AOI theme as a collapsible accordion section, exposing key claims, philosophical commitments, argumentative moves, and source documents per theme, with the overall synthesis surfaced at the top as an orientating lead-in.
views.rationale: The thematic synthesis data is multi-faceted per theme — each theme carries a distinct set of sub-fields (claims, commitments, moves, sources) that differ in shape from one another. Accordion sections handle this heterogeneity cleanly, letting the critic scan themes at a glance and drill into any facet without visual overwhelm. prose_narrative would flatten the structured sub-fields; card_grid_grouped would lose the per-facet typed rendering that accordion uniquely provides.

items.overview: Benanav leans on Neurath's insistence that planning can coordinate production without market prices.
source_documents: Through War Economy to Economy in Kind
Economic Plan and Calculation in Kind

items.overview: Benanav partially echoes Neurath's view that planning depends on public knowledge infrastructures and civic intelligibility.

key_claims: Planning can orient production without market-clearing signals.
Material coordination can be treated as an information design problem.
Planning requires transparent social knowledge rather than hidden market revelation.

philosophical_commitments: Economic rationality is not exhausted by price signals.
Democratic coordination depends on shared intelligibility.

argumentative_moves: Recasts socialist calculation as a coordination problem rather than a scarcity-pricing puzzle.
Turns epistemic planning into a public-capacity argument.

items.label: Overall Pattern
items.content: The dossier fixture concentrates on one dominant Neurathian planning theme with a secondary civic-intelligibility theme.

views.description: Presents the full AOI report as a set of collapsible accordion sections — Summary, Engagement Pattern, Key Divergences, Sin Distribution, and Reading Implications — each rendered according to its own data shape, with badge-tagged divergence entries and sin-type tallies surfaced inline.
views.rationale: The report data is explicitly multi-typed: narrative prose fields (summary, engagement_pattern, reading_implications) sit alongside a badged array (key_divergences) and a counted typology (sin_distribution). Accordion sections is the canonical pattern for exactly this mix of facets with different shapes. Closing the page with this structured report fulfills the user intent to end on a formal analytical artifact, and the accordion's collapsibility lets the critic navigate directly to whichever report facet is most salient without scrolling through the full narrative.

items.content: Benanav's AOI pattern is dominated by one planning theme, with a secondary civic-intelligibility strand that stays visible but subordinate.
The engagement is strongest when Benanav reframes Neurath's planning arguments as contemporary coordination problems and weaker when Neurath's democratic epistemology would need to be foregrounded.

items.title: Planning becomes infrastructural coordination
items.subtitle: Calculation Without Prices
items.description: Benanav preserves the anti-price premise but redescribes it as infrastructural coordination.

items.title: Democratic pedagogy is compressed
items.subtitle: Planning as Public Knowledge
items.description: Neurath's public-education emphasis appears only as a secondary implication.
Two findings show strong borrowing with updated language.
One finding compresses Neurath's accounting doctrine into computational administration.

items.content: The dossier case reads Benanav as leaning heavily on one Neurathian planning strand while trimming the democratic and bureaucratic thickness that made the original view distinctive.
